jobs.title: Lead Nursing Faculty - NCLEX Coordinator
jobs.description: The role of the Lead Faculty – NCLEX Coordinator at the Atlanta campus will provide leadership and support for all aspects of the program related to preparing students for the Certification Exam in their specialty to maximize first time pass rates. This includes planning and delivering development to the faculty team to make certification preparation holistic in the classroom experience as well as preparing students throughout their lifespan. The role includes regular collaboration with system and campus leadership. The teaching assignment will include a preparation course in addition to other courses as appropriate.
